title: RPI 情侣控制欲/占有欲指数测评

resultConfig.formula: var dimWeights = { Control: 0.3, Jealousy: 0.25, Dependency: 0.2, Insecurity: 0.25 }; var weightedSum = 0; var totalWeight = 0; var dimScores = {}; var dimCounts = {}; for (var i = 0; i < answers.length; i++) { var a = answers[i]; if (a.dimensionKey && dimWeights[a.dimensionKey] !== undefined) { dimScores[a.dimensionKey] = (dimScores[a.dimensionKey] || 0) + a.value; dimCounts[a.dimensionKey] = (dimCounts[a.dimensionKey] || 0) + 1; } } for (var key in dimWeights) { if (dimCounts[key]) { var avg = dimScores[key] / dimCounts[key]; weightedSum += avg * dimWeights[key]; totalWeight += dimWeights[key]; } } var finalScore = totalWeight > 0 ? (weightedSum / totalWeight) : 0; var normalizedScore = ((finalScore - 1) / 6) * 100; var finalDimensions = {}; for (var k in dimScores) { finalDimensions[k] = Math.round(((dimScores[k] / dimCounts[k] - 1) / 6) * 100); } return { totalScore: Math.round(normalizedScore), rawAvg: Number(finalScore.toFixed(2)), dimensions: finalDimensions };

resultRules.title: 危险/需干预：高压控制型
resultRules.description: 您的占有欲指数极高，表现出强烈的控制倾向和关系不安全感。这可能已经对伴侣造成了心理压力，建议寻求专业心理咨询，探讨不安全感的根源。

resultRules.title: 高：显著占有倾向
resultRules.description: 您在关系中表现出明显的占有倾向和嫉妒心。虽然这可能源于对关系的在乎，但过度的干预可能会损害双方的信任。建议学习建立健康的边界感。

resultRules.title: 中：轻度焦虑/依赖
resultRules.description: 您在关系中偶尔会感到不安或产生依赖，这属于比较常见的状态。通过加强沟通和提升自我价值感，可以建立更稳固的安全感。

resultRules.title: 低：健康安稳型
resultRules.description: 您的关系非常健康，表现出高度的信任和清晰的边界。您和伴侣都能在关系中感到自由且安全，请继续保持这种积极的互动模式。
